name: Agent finds it
title: John needs a dataset.
body: His AI agent finds a useful developer dataset for $10. John wants the file, but he doesn't want to hand over control of his wallet.

name: No blank check
title: His money. His decision.
body: An agent shouldn't have unrestricted spending power. John wants to buy this one file, not give an agent permission to spend whenever it wants.

name: John says yes
title: One file. One approval.
body: John sees the seller, the $10 price and the file he's getting. He sets a maximum source spend of 11 USDC and approves this one purchase.

name: Payment verified
title: Paid on Arbitrum. Received on Base.
body: John sends about $10.11 from his Arbitrum wallet. NEAR Intents handles the cross-chain payment, and RouteTill verifies that the merchant received exactly $10 on Base.

name: File + proof
title: Delivered. With proof.
body: RouteTill verifies the merchant payment, delivers the correct dataset exactly once, and issues a signed Purchase Passport anyone can check.
